scripts.lint:noc-guard: sh -c 'dirs=""; for d in src/components/df "src/app/(design)"; do [ -d "$d" ] && dirs="$dirs $d"; done; if [ -z "$dirs" ]; then echo "noc-guard: no v2 surfaces yet"; exit 0; fi; out=$(grep -rnE "(--color-status-|--color-brand[a-z-]*|text-status-|bg-status-|border-status-|ring-status-|text-brand|bg-brand|border-brand|font-display|--font-saira|--font-inter)" $dirs --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" --include="*.css"); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo "noc-guard FAIL: NOC token on a v2 surface:"; echo "$out"; exit 1; fi; if [ "$rc" -ge 2 ]; then echo "noc-guard ERROR (grep rc=$rc)"; exit "$rc"; fi; echo "noc-guard: v2 surfaces clean"; exit 0'
